timeline.tweet: We can be traveling alone buddies (I do it all the time & you'll do great, promise!) Just remember that most of the people there are in the same circumstances you are, a lot of them dealing with anxiety over the IRL side of it all. Just breathe and know you aren't alone in it...

I struggled with that for a VERY long time. In high school I was diagnosed with depression and my response was "NO! I can't be depressed, I'm happy!" Not all depression manifests that way - most actually doesn't. In 2012 I was told that I also have PTSD and once again, ...
Every. Single. Time. I often put things in "safe places," which is basically it's death sentence to a life lived lost forever.
